notes: The ASV restructures the chain into three English genitives; each *of* is placed on the nominal it stands before (rule 19), the middle one going to the substantivized attributive rather than being marked `added` (rule 8).

*put thy trust*: the dative's suffix takes the possessive determiner and the preposition is `unrepresented` (rule 40); *How* is an interrogative with an English word of its own, so the fronted auxiliary stays with the verb (rule 17).
